text: This synthetic preface introduces processes, threads, scheduling, synchronization, virtual memory, and file systems. Students should already have familiarity with computer architecture and data structures. Each process uses memory and may communicate with another process while the scheduler selects useful work. A thread shares resources with related threads, while synchronization protects shared state. Later sections explain page replacement, storage management, security, and access control with clear examples. The material is entirely invented for deterministic offline testing and contains no third party book text.
